summary: In ansible-core 2.22, inferring failure from a non-zero rc without failed emits a runtime deprecation warning; modules must set failed explicitly, and inference is removed in 2.24.
questions: Why do I get a deprecation warning about rc in ansible-core 2.22?
When will rc-based failure inference be removed?

answer_card.title: rc-based failure inference now warns
answer_card.answer_md: Treating a non-zero `rc` with no `failed` value as a failure is deprecated and now emits a **runtime deprecation warning**. Modules and actions must report failure explicitly by setting `failed: true`, using `fail_json`, or raising an unhandled error. When inference is removed in **2.24**, `rc` gets no special treatment.
